_comment: Guided tour for the Project Browser. Each step points at a real control (the key the app remembers its rectangle under); the action steps wait for the user to use it. Read by chisurf.emtk.help_guide.

steps.title: Sessions you can come back to
steps.text: A project is a saved session — datasets, fits, parameters and instrument state — kept in the project database. Every save adds a version; nothing is overwritten.

steps.title: Load the list
steps.text: Refresh reads the projects you may see from the database: your own, and the public ones of other users while Show public is ticked.

steps.title: Find one
steps.text: The search matches project names, identifiers, owners and version notes.

steps.title: Project or exact version
steps.text: Selecting a project row means its newest version; + expands it to the stored versions, each with its notes. Select one.

await.hint: Click a project or version row.

steps.title: What is in it
steps.text: Inspect stored version lists the version's artifacts, fitted parameter values, branches and parents — check it before restoring over your current session.

steps.title: Restore it
steps.text: Open / Restore replaces the current session with the selected version and reopens its fit windows. Double-clicking a row does the same.

steps.title: Keep your own work
steps.text: Save Current Project stores the session as a new version of the project it came from (or as a new project). Export .cs.pto and Import Project move one version between databases as a single file; an import checks for clashing IDs first.
